t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The best basket to use will vary between rounds. The red, brown and purple gnomes are linked to the yellow basket and the others are linked to the other basket. Switch between the two as you notice the baskets struggling to collect more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: The red, brown and purple gnomes are linked to the red basket, and the others are linked to the yellow basket. At some points in the game, the red basket will earn more points and at other times, the yellow basket will earn you more. Keep an eye on which basket is earning more at that time in the game and stick to the coloured gnomes that are linked to that particular basket. Be extra careful on the 5x multiplier rounds as these provide the best opportunity to earn big points.
